Community Rules

Lighter Together is a peer-support space. Please keep it kind, safe and honest.

  • Be respectful. No shaming, bullying, insults or comments about anyone's body.
  • Protect your privacy. Use a nickname. Do not post your full name, phone number, address or medical records.
  • No medical orders. Share your own experience, not instructions for others. Talk to your doctor before changing treatment, diet or medication.
  • No selling or promotion. No ads, links to shops, supplements, or sources for prescription drugs.
  • No dangerous advice. Posts that encourage extreme dieting, purging, or ignoring medical care will be removed.
  • Be honest. Do not invent stories or results.

How moderation works

Every story, question and reply is reviewed before it appears. Use the Report button on any answer or question that breaks these rules. We may edit or remove content at any time.

If you are in crisis or need urgent medical help, contact your local emergency number or a healthcare professional.

Questions or removal requests: contact us.
